result.title: TokenFlow: Latent Token Rectified Flow Matching for 3D Point Cloud Generation
result.summary: 3D point clouds generation requires capturing both part-level layout and surface detail while preserving permutation equivariance. Existing latent generative models often encode an entire shape into a single vector, which limits their ability to retain part-level structure. We propose TokenFlow, a hierarchical flow matching framework that represents each shape as a set of latent tokens and couples a rectified flow over these tokens with a conditional flow over points. A bottleneck of $M \ll N$ learnable tokens aggregates global context through cross-attention at $O(NM)$ cost. On ShapeNet, TokenFlow achieves the best MMD and coverage across airplane, car, and chair, while obtaining 1-NNA comparable to the strongest baselines. On ModelNet, its learned latent set reaches the best reported linear-evaluation accuracy on ModelNet10. These results show that representing a shape as a set of latent tokens, aggregated at $O(NM)$ cost, provides an effective representation for 3D point cloud generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TokenFlow，用少量可学习 latent token 表示三维形状，在 token 集合上做 rectified flow 并与点级条件流耦合，以 O(NM) 的交叉注意力聚合全局信息，在 ShapeNet、ModelNet 上评估点云生成质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单向量编码丢失部件级结构」的动机与用 latent token 集合承载结构、并以 flow 迭代更新状态的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉细节保留、信息坍缩及 latent 状态更新问题可供核查；但任务为三维生成，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
